name: Setup Wizard rescue keeps a stored altitude hold on On
step: Check that On keeps ALT_HOLD and that ALT_HOLD shows as On
rationale:
Issue #2688: the rescue step offers Off and On, and On wrote CLIMB (1) over a stored ALT_HOLD (2),
while a stored ALT_HOLD did not match either choice.

The harness drives the real setup_wizard_rescue.lua against a simulated flight controller with one rescue
profile per PID profile, and pins: ALT_HOLD shows as On and On keeps it on every profile; Off then On writes
CLIMB; a stored CLIMB stays CLIMB.

--self-test removes the line that keeps ALT_HOLD and requires the ALT_HOLD check to go red.
